Calling all chocolate lovers! This International Chocolate Day, we’re taking chocolate beyond the usual sweet treat and turning it into some incredibly delicious and indulgent creations!
From a warm and comforting Hot Chocolate to a rich and creamy Chocolate Delice, a surprisingly delicious Chocolate Hummus, and a soft, moist Eggless Chocolate Almond Cake, this episode is packed with irresistible ways to enjoy chocolate.
Hot Chocolate with Toasted Marshmallow
Chocolate Delice with Fig
Chocolate Hummus
Eggless Chocolate Almond Cake
